governance_rules: No dependency installation without human approval.
No OpenAI/network-backed execution without explicit approval.
All adapter capability checks must be ledgered.
All adapter executions must be ledgered.
Warnings/errors must flow through self-correction governance.
purpose: Introduce governed adapter execution layer for local deterministic, LangGraph, and OpenAI-agent paths.
truth_boundary: Phase 13D creates adapter execution controls and executes the local deterministic adapter. It does not falsely claim LangGraph/OpenAI execution unless those adapters are explicitly enabled.
